title: Spyglass is Officially Live!
summary: The powerful Spyglass tool has officially launched, moving beyond beta to provide enhanced capabilities and insights for all users.

title: Enhanced File Management for Your Editor
summary: Experience a new level of control over your content with our enhanced file management system, allowing you to easily upload, download, and customize how files appear in your editor for a seamless creative process.

title: Introducing Our Dynamic Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap, providing a transparent view into our latest achievements, upcoming features, and future plans to keep you informed every step of the way.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes: Effortless Task Management
summary: We've made your task management even smoother with redesigned checkboxes that are now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable for a more intuitive experience.

title: Smarter Collaborative Editing
summary: We've dramatically improved the real-time collaboration experience, making it simpler and clearer to work together with your team.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Collaborate more effectively and discover shared items with ease, making teamwork smoother than ever.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Prepare to experience Noeko in your preferred language as we expand our support to include a rich variety of international languages, making our platform accessible to everyone.

title: Open Source Noeko
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower our community with maximum control, foster direct involvement in the project's evolution, and ensure complete transparency.

title: Personalized Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflows with an enhanced knowledge map that allows you to dynamically filter by tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Refined Search & Custom Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with powerful new filters, sorting options, and the ability to save custom search collections for instant access.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: Experience enhanced flexibility in structuring your notes with interactive content previews, making it easier to connect and visualize your ideas.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting & Tailored Plans
summary: Prepare for enhanced flexibility as Noeko introduces self-hostable options for individual users and new cloud-hosted plans with powerful enterprise features for teams.

title: Elevate Your Workspace: Stunning New and Improved Themes
summary: We're thrilled to introduce a vibrant collection of new themes and significant enhancements to existing ones, empowering you to personalize your workspace with beautiful, high-contrast visual styles.

title: Seamlessly Personalized Welcome
summary: We're enhancing your experience with intelligently timed greetings that always reflect the exact time of day wherever you are, ensuring a truly personalized welcome.

title: Faster Tag Management Actions
summary: Efficiently organize your content by quickly removing items from tags directly within their dedicated list view, saving you valuable time.

title: Unleash Your Information with More Source Types
summary: Get ready to seamlessly bring in information from a wider range of sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to connect all your valuable content in one place.
